text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The gym today is filled with a strange sort of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Good. I'm in perfect communication with my triceps. Everything's in tip-top condition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do it today!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Did you hear?! Ryan's gonna challenge the heavy barbells!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: The ones nobody can lift? That might be impossible even for her…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haha, don't you worry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: My exceptional muscles don't know the meaning of "impossible"!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Ryan! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Eight… nine! Pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Just one more rep to complete three sets! She really might do it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: …But she's struggling! Come on, stay strong, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: …YAH!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… Muscles… make it possible!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Congratulations! Wow… I've never seen anything like that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haha, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I could show everyone that nothing's out of reach if you have well-toned muscles!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After lifting the heaviest weights, it seems like Mejiro Ryan has grown even more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ngh! My arms…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: That was a nice attempt, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you! But it looks like I still have some work left to do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm going to train harder. And then I'll show you all the true potential of muscle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she failed at lifting the weights, Mejiro Ryan seems to have grown even more from the experience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Roar… my… MUSCLES!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant… My muscles have no limit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Indeed! What wonderful strength you have, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes… I was taken aback. I knew you were impressive, but I never expected that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow, you were both watching! I'm so glad!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey, I know! How about you two give it a try? Let's work up a sweat together and push it to the limit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Why, yes. It would be splendid if we could train together. I would love to be as brawny as you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm happy to join you two, but… I'll be fine with just becoming a little brawny!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her weightlifting a great success, Mejiro Ryan seems to have grown a lot!
